bio: From your comfortable vantage point beneath a tiled roof by the pool, savour the view of the sweet-scented scrubland and the sea. The repertory, which displays a distinctly modern Mediterranean slant, stars Corsican produce: premium cured meats; local veal in olives with creamy polenta; lemon-flavoured Corsican cheesecake (fiadone). The concise menu is comprised of seasonal ingredients. A single set menu on Tuesdays features island specialties....
